import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path(s)
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_6/test_0.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from all sources
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Select only relevant columns for the target schema
        # Target schema: ['provider_id': int, 'provider_name': str, 'provider_zip_code': int,
        # 'average_covered_charges': float, 'average_total_payments': float, 'average_medicare_payments': float]
        df = df[['provider_id', 'provider_name', 'provider_zip_code',
                 'average_covered_charges', 'average_total_payments', 'average_medicare_payments']]

        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes (if multiple)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Group by provider_id, provider_name, provider_zip_code to aggregate numeric columns by average
    # This is because source data may have multiple rows per provider with different DRG or other info
    grouped_df = combined_df.groupby(
        ['provider_id', 'provider_name', 'provider_zip_code'], as_index=False
    ).agg({
        'average_covered_charges': 'mean',
        'average_total_payments': 'mean',
        'average_medicare_payments': 'mean'
    })

    # Cast columns to target schema types explicitly
    grouped_df['provider_id'] = grouped_df['provider_id'].astype(int)
    grouped_df['provider_name'] = grouped_df['provider_name'].astype(str)
    grouped_df['provider_zip_code'] = grouped_df['provider_zip_code'].astype(int)
    grouped_df['average_covered_charges'] = grouped_df['average_covered_charges'].astype(float)
    grouped_df['average_total_payments'] = grouped_df['average_total_payments'].astype(float)
    grouped_df['average_medicare_payments'] = grouped_df['average_medicare_payments'].astype(float)

    # Write the transformed data to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_6/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    grouped_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
